column1: # unit-464class — the hand read, which is the verdict. 48 call sites, one row each.
# Keyed per CALL SITE, not per id: a REFUSE-SITE id repeats, and `C0` in
# unit-464vac/grade-cure.mjs is GATE at two of its three sites and CROSS-STATE at the third.
# The id is not the unit.
# b0de039bd79f3fa30daba69353d2eeaf48c42a2e, plus the enclosing source where a span referenced an
# identifier (noted in `why`). Written BEFORE classify-and-grade.mjs existed.
# class:   PIN | GATE | CROSS-STATE | UNMODELLED        (the four registered buckets)
# subkind: delta | keyed | -                            (UNREGISTERED reading, see RESULTS §4)
#   delta — the predicate asserts the two states DIFFER. A correct cure makes it TRUE.
#   keyed — the predicate asserts the frozen artefact and the live-derived figure AGREE.
#           A correct cure makes it FALSE. This is the hazard half.
